name: OpenVibe.Trade

exposure.note: the domain serves the OpenVibe.Sites placeholder page

site.name: Trade
site.what: Informational watchlists, sourced market context and alerts. No custody, no order execution.

liveness.means: the process is up and answers HTTP; it checks nothing else (the database and dependencies are what ready checks)

resumes.what: the OpenVibe.Sources change feed is pulled again from the stored cursor, so items published during the stop arrive (idempotent per item revision)
freshness is re-evaluated on Trade's clock; documents whose gate changed are sent again
OpenVibe.Events redelivers sources.item.* and sources.fetch.failed that were pending during the stop (at least once, deduped by event_id)
unsent events in the outbox table go to OpenVibe.Events once the relay starts (at least once; Events dedupes by event_id)

conditions: automatic: ovhost deploy puts the previous sha back and restarts again when the ready URL does not answer 2xx within ready.timeoutSeconds after the restart (exit 3)
rollback.window: automatic only while ovhost waits for readiness after the restart (30 s in host.example.json); manual afterwards, as long as no blocker applies

blockers.none: the schema code only adds (CREATE … IF NOT EXISTS, ADD COLUMN; no DROP, RENAME or table rebuild), which an older release ignores

leases.none: no claims: one process owns trade.db (better-sqlite3, single writer)

notes: Port 4860. Informational only (ADR-025): no custody, order execution, escrow, listings between users or personalised advice. Owns trade_instruments, trade_instrument_aliases, trade_watchlists, trade_watchlist_items, trade_market_observations, trade_source_documents, trade_alert_rules, trade_alert_deliveries, trade_context_revisions in its own SQLite. Reads OpenVibe.Sources (sources.item.read, sources.source.read, category trade) by cursor and wakes on signed sources.* webhook deliveries; consumes OpenVibe.AI trade.summarize_market_context output as reviewed drafts; publishes through OpenVibe.Events (events.event.publish); OpenVibe.Search reads trade.index_document.* from Events.
